find: if (state.steps.some((step) => 'breakWebgl' in step)) return 'the match failure overlay, owned by its own capture';
why: Issue #710. The sweep stops excluding the state that breaks WebGL after boot, so the gate starts a match it deliberately fails. Killed by the exclusion-map case and the swept-list case (1 more id).
